==Notes==
* This bonus is gained by using a [[Party Beacon]].
* This effect increases the duration of visual effects for [[firework]]s (e.g. [[Sparkler]]s).
* This effect will also cause your [[character]] to glow slightly, similar to when enchanted with [[Divine Fire]]. A higher{{verify|There's only two title tiers, so tier 1 or 2?}} [[Party Animal]] title lowers the chance of getting the glowing effect.

==Trivia==
* Has a similar [[skill icon]] as [[Party Time!]].
